reviews.text: The puppy socials were so great! We also were struggling with some fear/anxiety with our puppy and Suzanne and Melissa helped us solve the problem in just two private sessions. Highly recommend!

Best philosophy I've ever heard.
I haven even been here, but I called them and asked a ton of questions and this IS the only place I would EVER take my pup.
They have a no harm philosophy. No stupid prong collars or any of that pseudoscience that prong collar enjoyers believe.
10 ⭐ rating!

Leap’s 10 year bday is today!  She was an 8 week puppy when she came home & soon after started puppy training, leash walking, recall and socials with Amanda & her team.
Not a day goes by that I don’t think about the foundational skills WE received and how much easier & more fulfilling they make our lives today.  Thanks Amanda & Team!!!

We first went to Amanda Gagnon because we knew our puppy needed basic manners and training to have her best life here in NYC but we kept coming back because of how extraordinary and excellent the team is at Amanda Gagnon. They are kind, they are fun, they are so knowledgeable about all dog-things. They bonded so quickly with our pup to the point that our puppy was pulling into their entrance whenever we passed by their doors. Specifically, Liz was an expert in helping us connect and train our pup and has gone beyond expectations of what we could have imagined. Sarah was also a trainer that helped us in our early classes and she was so loving, caring and resourceful in helping us learn how to best train our puppy. Couldn't be happier to have come here and couldn't be more excited to keep coming back.

6/5 stars

We had an amazing experience working with Melissa for our reactive and fearful rescue dachshund, Bonnie. Melissa shed so much light on Bonnie's demeanor, helping us understand her triggers and sensitivities on a deeper level.

After only a few sessions, we felt equipped with the tools we needed for our training at home and we've seen such a dramatic, positive difference in Bonnie’s behavior in the few months since. Melissa is incredibly knowledgeable and such a pleasure to work with!!

My husband and I have a five year old Whoodle (wheaten terrier and poodle mix). She has issues with resource guarding with myself and my husband when we are around other dogs. We’ve seen various trainers over the years with mix success and assurance over their credentials.

After long deliberation and research, we decided to get another Whoodle puppy. My husband has allergies to dogs and this is one of the few breeds he has found that do not cause inflammation. I was very anxious about the situation in case our current dog would be aggressive or unsettled with the addition. Before we got the puppy, we consulted with our vet, Heart of Chelsea (who is generally amazing). Heart of Chelsea recommend we contact one of their preferred trainers, which included Amanda Gagnon dog training.

From the point of booking the initial session, they were lovely to work with. Their services might be slightly more expensive that the neighborhood dog trainer, but they are worth every penny as these people are the real deal. Melissa came to our apartment to meet our current dog and help us with some tips on how to integrate a puppy as well as how to approach our dog’s aggressive behavior toward other dogs. Melissa so professional, smart, but also real. It didn’t feel like she was in any way judgmental or condescending. She offered great advice in person and also via email for follow-up questions. We had her come back again after we get the puppy to check-in on approach and progress. Their services SIGNIFICANTLY reduced my angst about the new puppy situation and made me feel like I had realistic, logical, and positive methods to tackle the situation.

I cannot recommend this Company more for care with your beloved dogs. Melissa and Amanda Gagnon are now go-to resources for us in making sure our furry family members are happy and healthy.

Did not have a good experience and told puppy was too old for puppy social. The trainer went ahead and lock up my puppy in a corner of room. What is the point of trying to socialise my puppy if she’s locked up in an area.

Puppy social area is just like a back store room, not a lot of light. Went once and never again.
Terrible experience with my puppy here

We were introduced to AGDT by a friend, who had a successful experience with their dog.  We were the unexpected owners of a Cavapoo puppy and were desperate for help.  My initial contact was with Matt, who was wonderful.   We had a challenging scheduling issue, but Matt was determined to make it work and he came through in a big way; he truly exemplifies customer service and AGDT is lucky to have him. Matt set us up with  Coralys, a certified dog trainer, who was new to the AGDT team.  She is a dog whisperer, pure and simple, and I think a human one, as well.  She patiently worked with our pup and with us; trust me, we needed more work than the puppy.  Bottom line is that she has taught us what to look for in our dog, how to redirect and reward, and our lives have all been changed for the better. Coralys does private training as well as classes, and she is simply amazing, following up with us via email after each visit with notes about what we worked on and worksheets on what to do.  Also want to give a shout out to AGDT for their free, online call-in sessions for puppy assistance, which we did in the days leading up to our initial appointment with Coralys; it was a lifesaver!  Grateful to Matt, to Coralys and to the AGDT team!

I have been working with Melissa Arbitman to train my dog to go into a dog carrier and to master obedience commands in a distracted environment..She is amazing. She has so many different ways to alleviate my dog's anxiety and my dog responds quickly and consistently. Have had other trainers but nothing worked as well as with Melissa. I also a few years back enrolled her in a dog agility group class with Denver and that also was excellent.

I have nothing but praise for the trainers, staff, and programs at AGDT.  My dog, Teddy, a Havanese who is currently 6 months old, loves participating in the classes and socials.  He always comes home tired and happy.  The trainers are fantastic and provide great advice and tips .  Teddy attended Puppy Kindergarten, Puppy Level 2, and now goes to Day School at least once a week.  He has learned so much (as have I) and is very well socialized because of his interaction with the other dogs and humans.  I am happy that the socials are supervised by trainers, who monitor the dogs interactions and engage them in play. Also, the staff is incredibly friendly, responsive, and patient.  I am so glad that I discovered AGDT and have taken advantage of all it has to offer.  Teddy wanted me to give them a 10-paw rating!

I can’t say enough good things about AGDT!  I adopted my rescue ChaCha at 10 months old and she was having trouble adjusting to her new life with me and in the city. Their free decompression workshop was really informative, helping set expectations and giving lots of tips on how to make a rescue more comfortable. We signed up for 1:1 sessions with Liz Kelsay, who was amazing!  Liz was super friendly, flexible, and knowledgeable about my dog’s unique challenges, not to mention ChaCha loves her!!  She was able to address all our needs from learning how to walk on a leash without darting into traffic, basic commands like sit,  to tricks like rolling over and sitting pretty, all with only positive reinforcement.   Would 100% recommend Liz and AGDT!

The 6-week dog reactivity class changed our lives and helped us so much with our reactive dog! We learned how to identify her triggers and help her modify her behaviors. We’ve noticed such a difference in just 6 weeks and have the tools we need to keep practicing with her! Our trainer Melissa is great and so patient. Highly highly recommend AGDT!

Our golden retriever puppy did kindergarten & attended 10 puppy day school sessions here. He LOVED it, to the point where we can’t walk within 2 blocks of the place unless we’re taking him to school or else he starts crying to go! He learned so much, and there were noticeable improvements in his skills after each session. He loved his puppy friends & having this outlet was invaluable to us before he finished all his vaccines.
The only reason why I gave 3 stars is because we didn’t have a great experience with the regular day school (once he was too old for puppy school) so he only went once. Within 30 minutes of getting home after we picked him up he could no longer walk and developed a distended stomach. After X-Rays and vet examination it turns out he had gorged himself on food (no air in his stomach- just ALL food) and it took a full 24 hours before his stomach went down and he could eat again. And then 24 hours of acid reflux and treatment after that. (All up around $700 in vet bills)
We’re still really confused about what happened, but since he is sooo closely supervised at home and it happened so quickly after getting back it just seems most likely something happened at school. It’s super disappointing because we loved sending him here and he just absolutely loved going.

I’ve been to a few dog trainers in the past with my first dog who mostly taught how to teach your dog cues. This school is much more holistic, teaching you how to teach your dog regulation, impulse control, capturing behaviors, and building your relationship with your dog. Rather than just outlining the steps to teach a particular behavior, they explain the theory, principles, and behavioral science of positive reinforcement training. I’ve been extremely impressed and grateful to have found it.

My puppy has attended the socials, day school, adolescent level 1, and a recall workshop and all of the trainers have been extremely knowledgeable, kind, and go above and beyond to be helpful. We especially appreciated how much individual attention and support we got from Suzanne in adolescent level 1. Liz taught our recall workshop and after only one of the three sessions, my puppy improved drastically in her recall. Melissa has been incredibly helpful in helping us choose which programs to attend and explaining the behavioral issues my puppy was displaying. Michelle has given us such detailed and helpful feedback after day school so I can continue building on the skills my puppy is learning there. Day School has been a miracle. My puppy’s leash skills and impulse control have improved so much more rapidly since she started attending. I felt like I was working on training her every minute of the day I wasn’t at work and it was still slow going, but since she started day school, I see marked improvements every week. Day School and the socials have also been an excellent outlet for her to play with other dogs safely (unlike at the dog park which can be unpredictable) and wear herself out which has been sanity saving for me.

Every trainer we have met here has seemed like a true dog lover and excited to help us with our journey, I’m only sorry I can’t recall everyone’s name to mention them specifically in this review, but anyone who works here is obviously an excellent trainer. The administrative staff has also been so lovely and warm and made me feel they are invested in my puppy too! We got to meet Amanda once and I felt she personally cared about me and my puppy even though I’m sure she’s very busy as the owner of the school. It feels not just like a training school, but a community for me and my puppy. I plan to sign my puppy up for every course offered here and would recommend this school highly to anyone.

I have worked with Amanda Gagnon with my new rescue pitbull Macy. I have worked on 1-1 training and done the dayschools.  This has been invaluable to me, as a first time dog owner, and with a high energy and challenging rescue. My trainer offered valuable training to ME the owner as well as Macy. She is patient, caring and incredibly knowledgeable. Our sessions are definitely equal parts human therapy and dog training - which is so important. In our first week of ownership she helped me organize a care plan for Macy when I had to go out of town - and she didn’t even know us that well! She has helped me find a reliable and caring regular dogwalker and helped me navigate a seemingly endless stream of health issues and complications. She also loves Macy and has helped her get to the point where she can play with other dogs (mostly!). The dayschools offer a supervised play opportunity, which was critical to me having a bully breed who likes to play rough. They have taught her how to moderate her play style and made me so much more comfortable taking her out and about. Also, she LOVES going to school and then promptly passes out for 3 hours on return. So it gives me an all day win.
Great customer service and a good place to help train your dog. Check it out! Your dog will thank you.

Amanda Gagnon Dog Training is an invaluable resource!  I am thrilled to have consulted with different members their staff over the course of Lucky Bambino's four and a half years with us.  The attached photo shows Lucky after a recent private session with awesome trainer, Michelle Formato.  I always come away from our dog training sessions a better human :)
Thank you, Amanda Gagnon Dog Training!

I took an APDT hosted class on puppy classes with Amanda. I've been running puppy classes for a few years now, but I still feel like I learned a ton! Thanks for a great class, Amanda! I have lots of new ideas to implement in my classes going forward!
Amanda’s staff is extremely knowledgeable about your dogs breed and the best way to work with them to achieve your goals for you and your puppy!

Bisou started training with Michelle at about 4 months old via Amanda Gagnon Puppy Kindergarten program and it was amazing! She met her first new puppy friends there and I received the support and education I needed to help Bisou grow into a well adjusted and confident puppy. We loved the trainings and Michelle's approach so much, upon graduation we enrolled in adolescents day school for continued support + socialization for Bisou. Let me tell you Bisou is one happy pup thanks to Michelle and the Amanda Gagnon Dog Training School and looks forward to going to day school every week!
